Recorded reloads and weapon action sounds

Original recordings from The Free Firearm Sound Library by Ben Jaszczak,
Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras and Matthew Nanney. Released under CC0 1.0.
https://opengameart.org/content/the-free-firearm-sound-library
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Source archive, master recording index and license
https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/tree/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/Master%20Tracks
https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/blob/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/Master%20Sheet.xlsx
https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/blob/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/LICENSE

Cue                Source directory                 Master take(s)

sniperSeat         Tikka                            W_4

pumpClose          Model 12                         K_5

revolver.ogg contains separate excerpts from the Smith & Wesson 642 sessions:
cylinderOpen       V_0, 1.487 s                      165 ms
cylinderEject      V_3, 1.162 s                      245 ms
loaderSeat         V_2, 1.127 s                      170 ms
cylinderClose      V_1, 1.247 s                      190 ms

The game uses short excerpts at their recorded pitch. Edits include mono
downmixing, low-frequency rumble filtering, level adjustment, trimming,
short edge fades and Ogg Opus encoding. The two Tikka cues join recorded
lift and pull sounds, and forward travel and latch sounds, respectively.
